defects_fixed.cause: the frozen cost_gate applies max(min_rr, cost_margin) as its reward/risk floor, so a book whose registered min_rr (1.2 and 0.5) sits below its declared cost_margin (1.5) carries a requirement that is unsatisfiable by construction — the same defect class DEF-EDGE01-01 recorded for the frozen campaign, where a candidate printed signals and never traded one of them.
defects_fixed.evidence: the per-arm funnels of both affected arms (zero trades and zero refusals on DEV, VAL and OOS before the fix) and the hashes above, absent from every book under test
defects_fixed.fix: the reward/risk of both books was made satisfiable by design rather than by weakening a gate: Q-2 moved to a 2.0 ATR stop against a 3.0 ATR objective (R:R 1.5) and Q-3 to an ATR-denominated dislocation (entry at least 3.0 ATR below the 20-day mean, 2.0 ATR stop, objective the mean), both with min_rr = cost_margin = 1.5, so the gate judges each setup instead of refusing the book.
defects_fixed.found: by running the screen, before the registration was committed and before any bar of the cross-section was aggregated or measured
defects_fixed.symptom: two registered QUALITY books produced no trades at all on the screening ground: edge08_quality_pullback_daily and edge08_quality_reversion_daily could not fire, the second of them on any bar of a three-year corpus.
defects_fixed.what_did_not_happen: no criterion, window, cost scenario or risk limit moved; the two books' signals are what changed, and the cross-section had not been touched when they did

limitations: the cost plane is venue-level: no per-symbol spread or book depth is modelled, and the ADVERSE scenario is the only sensitivity that speaks to thinner names
